name: lucid-labs-lims
description: Lucid Labs Laboratory Information Management System

scripts.build: npm run build -w @lims/api && npm run build -w @lims/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @lims/shared && npm run typecheck -w @lims/api && npm run typecheck -w @lims/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @lims/shared && npm run test -w @lims/api
